about: Plympton-Wyoming is a town in Lambton County, Ontario, inland and along Lake Huron just east of Sarnia—not Sarnia itself. The village of Wyoming is the municipal centre; lakeshore hamlets such as Camlachie sit among farms and the chemical-valley fringe. About 8,000 people live in Plympton-Wyoming.
